# Maryam Mumtaz

profile image url = "https://maryam-mumtaz.vercel.app/maryam.png"

> Maryam Mumtaz is a Pakistan-based AI Engineer, AI Agent Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, AI Automation Engineer, and Founder building intelligent software systems, AI agents, RAG applications, automation workflows, and scalable digital products.

Maryam Mumtaz is based in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. Her work combines agentic AI and LLM applications with Python and FastAPI backends, Next.js, React, and TypeScript frontends, API integrations, system design, cloud-native architecture, and workflow automation. Her portfolio documents freelance full-stack work since January 2025 and founding work on MARSA Empower since January 2026.

## Professional Summary

Maryam Mumtaz designs and builds production-oriented AI and software systems. Her documented work includes single-task AI agents, coordinated multi-agent systems, agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, AI workflow automation, AI-powered SaaS platforms, full-stack web applications, e-commerce systems, developer tools, and cloud-native services.

Her technical practice includes the OpenAI SDK and GPT models, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Dapr, and deployment workflows using platforms such as Vercel.

Maryam is open to full-time opportunities, freelance projects, consulting, and strategic partnerships. She also works independently on custom web applications, AI agents, automation workflows, and digital products.

## Hackathon Achievements

The current local portfolio records the same three entries as participation, so the winner status is a qualified company-page claim and is not treated as independently verified here. The portfolio identifies the following projects and events:

### Eventon Hackathon I — Physical AI Textbook

- AI-native educational platform for Physical AI and Humanoid Robotics.
- Custom RAG agents answer questions grounded in the textbook.
- Includes bilingual content and Urdu translation support.
- Technologies: Docusaurus, RAG, Python, cloud-native deployment.
- Live: https://ai-native-book-iota.vercel.app/
- Source status: listed as Participant in the portfolio card; listed as a winner on the MARSA team page.

### Eventon Hackathon II — Evolution of Todo

- AI-powered task-management system evolved from a simple todo application.
- Uses an event-driven architecture with Dapr and Kubernetes deployment.
- Technologies: OpenAI, Next.js, Dapr, Kubernetes.
- Live: https://todo-app-sigma-hazel-46.vercel.app/
- Source status: listed as Participant in the portfolio card; listed as a winner on the MARSA team page.

### Eventon Hackathon III — LearnFlow AI

- Autonomous learning platform with microservices, persistent learner memory, and struggle detection.
- Coordinates learning services through Kafka and Dapr.
- Technologies: Kafka, Next.js 15, Goose AI, Dapr.
- Live: https://frontend-rho-seven-ssq2gwtp54.vercel.app/
- Source status: listed as Participant in the portfolio card; listed as a winner on the MARSA team page.
